import sys

sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])

import shipping

parcels = [
    {"weight_kg": 0.05, "length": 10, "width": 10, "height": 5},
    {"weight_kg": 1.5, "length": 40, "width": 30, "height": 20, "fragile": True},
    {"weight_kg": 12, "length": 60, "width": 40, "height": 40},
    {"weight_kg": 2.0, "length": 10, "width": 10, "height": 10},
]
for parcel in parcels:
    print(shipping.domestic_quote(parcel))
    for zone in ("eu", "apac", "mars"):
        print(zone, shipping.international_quote(parcel, zone))
for func, args in ((shipping.domestic_quote, ({"weight_kg": 1},)), (shipping.international_quote, ({"length": 1}, "eu"))):
    try:
        func(*args)
    except KeyError as exc:
        print(func.__name__, "KeyError", exc)
print("ok")
